data.name: Akramul
data.gender_notes: Akramul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akrama', meaning 'unconquered'. It is a name of strength and valor, evoking images of fearless warriors and invincible heroes. The name Akramul carries the meaning “Unconquered” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akramul usually hope their child will grow to embody unconquered and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of courage and and determination
data.etymology: Akramul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unconquered.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akramul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Akramul holds a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition. It carries an aura of authority, bravery, and power, reminiscent of ancient Hindu warriors and kings. Akramul can be seen as a tribute to the valor and courage displayed by these historical figures. It is a name that resonates with the fierce spirit of the Hindu people, inspiring pride and confidence.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the spiritual significance of Akramul lies in its deeper meaning: an unconquered soul. This name symbolizes an individual who remains steadfast and undeterred in their beliefs and values, despite facing challenges and obstacles. Akramul can be seen as a reminder to remain true to one's spiritual path and to never give in to the distractions and temptations of the material world. It is a name that inspires self-discipline, determination, and perseverance in the spiritual realm.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Akramul: The Unassailable One. In Hindu philosophy, Akramul signifies one who is invulnerable and unconquerable due to their deep spiritual connection and inner peace. This name symbolizes the strength and resilience of the soul in the face of life's challenges.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Akramul was a general under the Muslim ruler, Alauddin Khalji, in the 13th century. The name Akramul carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Alauddin Khalji was the sultan of the Delhi Sultanate from 1296 to 1316. Akramul played a significant role in his military campaigns.
